name: Salesforce
summary: Creating an External Client App (formerly Connected App) in a free Developer Edition org takes about 30 minutes. Serving customers' orgs at scale typically means packaging, and AppExchange listing requires a paid security review.

verdict.label: Hard
verdict.headline: Works in your Dev org in about 30 minutes. AppExchange distribution means a paid security review that takes weeks.

approvalWait.appliesWhen: only if you list on AppExchange; customer orgs may also need admin pre-approval

timeline.summary: Fast for dev; distribution is the slow part

agent: Recommend scopes (api, refresh_token) and the right flow (web server + PKCE)
Draft the security-review questionnaire and the pen-test scope
Probe the authorize endpoint to confirm your consumer key (Salesforce rejects unknown keys without login)
human: Sign up for a free Developer Edition org (email verification)
Create the External Client App in Setup and copy the consumer key/secret
Pay the AppExchange security review fee and work with the Partner Community

steps.title: Get a Developer Edition org
steps.detail: Free sign-up at developer.salesforce.com/signup. You need email verification before you can sign in.

steps.title: Create an External Client App
steps.detail: Setup → External Client App Manager → New. Enable OAuth, set the callback URL, and choose scopes. Salesforce is steering new integrations from Connected Apps to External Client Apps.

steps.title: Wait for the app to propagate
steps.detail: New apps can take up to ~10 minutes before the consumer key is accepted.

evidence.note: Widely reported in docs and forums; not measured

steps.title: Validate the consumer key
steps.detail: Agent calls the authorize endpoint with your key. 'invalid_client_id' means it's not active yet, or you're using the wrong login host (use test.salesforce.com for sandboxes).

steps.title: (Distribution) AppExchange security review
steps.detail: Join the partner program, package the app, and submit for security review (fee, pen-test evidence, documentation).

evidence.note: Duration is inferred from community reports

requirements.note: Orgs can set apps to 'Admin approved users are pre-authorized'.

scopes.name: api
scopes.purpose: REST/SOAP API access as the user

evidence.note: Discovery advertises registration_endpoint, but POST without initial access token → 401

blockers.cause: The app hasn't propagated yet, or you're on the wrong login host.
blockers.fix: Wait about 10 minutes; use test.salesforce.com for sandbox orgs or the org's My Domain.

blockers.cause: The customer org blocks uninstalled connected apps.
blockers.fix: The customer admin installs or pre-approves the app (or you ship it as a managed package).

gotchas.title: A registration_endpoint doesn't mean open DCR
gotchas.detail: Salesforce's discovery document advertises /services/oauth2/register, but it needs an initial access token issued by an org admin. Agents can't self-register.

gotchas.title: Instance URL changes per org
gotchas.detail: Store instance_url from the token response; API calls go there, not to login.salesforce.com.

tested.result: 401: needs an initial access token, so no open DCR

uncertainties: The current security review fee and timeline should be confirmed with the Partner Community.
The rollout state of External Client App vs Connected App defaults varies by release.
